modules.name: Remotes
modules.description: Plays the Sequencer's patterns and saved chains from jacks, beside it on its left: pattern select, next and previous, bar sync, and pulses as patterns start and end

modules.name: Sequencer
modules.description: The OP-Z as one module: its face, eleven tracks of 16 steps, every engine, kit and send effect, step components, patterns, a mixer and ten project slots

modules.name: Synth Breakout
modules.description: Gives one of the Sequencer's synth tracks jacks: its sound out on its own, or its notes and CVs out and your own voice back in through the track

modules.name: Drum Breakout
modules.description: Gives one of the Sequencer's drum tracks jacks: its sound out on its own, or its triggers and CVs out and your own drums back in through the track

modules.name: Send FX Breakout
modules.description: Gives one of the Sequencer's FX tracks jacks: its effect out on its own, or its send and CVs out and your own effect back in through the track

modules.name: Screen
modules.description: Shows the Sequencer's selected track, like the OP-Z's phone app: every page and dial, turned by touch, and a drum track's kit editor
